# Home Companion acceptance

Run the public code contract baseline with `python -m pytest -q tests/test_home_companion.py tests/test_agent_recovery.py tests/test_home_companion_response.py tests/test_voice_agent.py tests/test_request_authority.py tests/test_mcp_tool_catalog.py`. The `profiles` in `v1.json` group these checks by execution, feedback and scope.

The tests drive real dispatch and Home Assistant state/service boundaries with scripted provider replies. They verify receipts, readback, approvals, cancellation, authority changes, discovery refinement, bounded counts, style/detail and failure feedback. Malformed-response correction retains prior reads and shares one bound with a tools-free read-report correction; it ends after a control attempt; a supplemental name-tie check prevents a model-selected singular candidate from replacing tied evidence. These checks do not establish that a hosted model interprets arbitrary prompts correctly.

Live qualification is a separate gate defined by `v1.json`. Use disposable lights and a token scoped only to those fixtures. Exercise the original natural-language prompts through real ingresses, compare all expected and forbidden effects, retain failed runs, and restore settings and fixtures. Count and style/detail checks must compare factual output with scoped tool evidence, not a model-authored reference answer. An unchanged state does not establish that no command was attempted.

`live-v1.json`, `live-fixtures.example.json` and `live-package.example.yaml` provide synthetic Voice qualification cases and disposable fixture examples. Cases cover natural and irregular wording, repetition, whole-room control, ambiguity, missing context, exact counts, mixed availability and style/detail pairs. Collect audit attempts and Home Assistant service events independently from before/after state, verify exact targets and operations, detect duplicate effects, and check factual feedback and recovery issues. Require every case exactly once and preserve failed evidence. Restore settings and fixtures after each run. Live collection and saved-evidence scoring tools are maintained separately and are not included in this repository. Agent Chat, AI Task, approvals and injected failures remain additional requirements in `v1.json`.
